title: With -dflambda-heavy-invariants, "Cannot rebind" on a match on a variant
summary: With `-dflambda-heavy-invariants` at `-O2` or `-O3` (the default join), Simplify stops on an ordinary match on a variant with constant and non-constant constructors: "Cannot rebind prim/... in environment".

actual.text: The compiler stops with `Cannot rebind ... in environment`, exit status 2.

cause: The level that the binary join builds (`middle_end/flambda2/types/join_levels_old.ml`) lists one variable under two binding times, so it is defined twice.

fix.text: Lists each variable under the binding time of the first use that defines it. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.
